{{Quote|Ah, the Jawas will salvage it eventually anyway. Then we can buy it back and start over. Heh. Makes sense to me.|The Czerka mining team captain to Revan referring to the sandcrawler|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
A '''Czerka mining team''' used a [[Unidentified Czerka sandcrawler|sandcrawler]] to cross the [[Dune Sea/Legends|Dune Sea]] led by a [[Unidentified Czerka mining team captain|mining captain]]. [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Sand People]] attacked the [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]], immobilizing it and sending multiple waves of Sand People to finish the team off. However [[Revan/Legends|Revan]] intervened and defended the mining team. They left the sandcrawler in the desert for the [[Jawa/Legends|Jawas]] to scavenge so they could buy it back from them.
